tools.name: get_dns_lookup
tools.description: Resolve ONE DNS record type for a domain. For all record types at once use /domain/intelligence; for a bundled DNS+TLS+headers audit use /web/audit or /security/posture; for mail-security plus a scored verdict use /domain/due-diligence.

tools.name: get_jwt_decode
tools.description: Decode a JWT payload without signature verification.

tools.name: get_subnet_calculate
tools.description: Calculate subnet information from CIDR notation.

tools.name: post_json_repair
tools.description: Repair common malformed JSON formatting issues.

tools.name: post_media_image_convert
tools.description: Convert an image between common formats (e.g. PNG/JPEG/WebP) from a URL or base64 payload.

tools.name: post_security_repo_risk_report_standard
tools.description: SBOM inventory plus real OSV.dev dependency-vulnerability matches and dependency-freshness signals for a public Git repository. One-shot alternative to a per-seat secret-scanning subscription.

tools.name: post_security_repo_risk_report_deep
tools.description: Everything in the standard report, plus a repo-wide secret/credential exposure scan (matched values are never returned).

tools.name: post_security_repo_risk_report_due_diligence
tools.description: Everything in the deep report, plus real OpenSSF Scorecard maintainer/governance signals and a prioritized recommendation. An automated baseline positioned against $5,000-$95,000 human technical due diligence.

tools.name: post_x402_service_trust_report
tools.description: Live, on-demand check of ONE x402-protected endpoint's payment-requirements structure, TLS certificate, and payTo on-chain balance before you pay it -- not a cached aggregate reputation score.

tools.name: post_freshdep_scan
tools.description: Flags pinned dependencies in a repository's requirements.txt, package-lock.json, or uv.lock published more recently than a freshness threshold -- a supply-chain-compromise tripwire. Free CLI (requirements.txt/package-lock.json only, uv.lock support pending there): github.com/sbakhour/freshdep.

tools.name: post_quebec_invoice_compliance_check
tools.description: Verifies GST/QST were calculated correctly per Revenu Quebec's current (non-compounded) formula, and flags whether a French invoice version is present per Charter of the French Language s.57/89/91. Pure arithmetic + text check; not legal or tax advice.

tools.name: post_quebec_invoice_generate
tools.description: Assembles a bilingual (French/English) Quebec invoice document with GST/QST computed exactly per Revenu Quebec's current formula -- you supply both languages' line-item text, this does not translate. Not legal or tax advice.

tools.name: post_json_validate
tools.description: Validate JSON text and return parsing details.

tools.name: post_json_pretty
tools.description: Pretty-print valid JSON text.

tools.name: post_json_minify
tools.description: Minify valid JSON text.

tools.name: post_base64_encode
tools.description: Encode UTF-8 text using Base64.

tools.name: post_base64_decode
tools.description: Decode Base64 to UTF-8 text.

tools.name: post_hash_sha256
tools.description: Generate SHA-256 digest from text.

tools.name: post_hash_sha512
tools.description: Generate SHA-512 digest from text.

tools.name: get_uuid_generate
tools.description: Generate a random UUID version 4.

tools.name: get_url_parse
tools.description: Parse a URL into structured components.

tools.name: post_text_stats
tools.description: Calculate character, word, line and byte statistics.

tools.name: post_text_dedupe_lines
tools.description: Remove duplicate lines while preserving original order.

tools.name: get_timestamp_convert
tools.description: Convert a Unix timestamp to UTC ISO-8601.

tools.name: post_domain_due_diligence
tools.description: The most comprehensive domain assessment: DNS + mail security (SPF/DKIM/DMARC) + TLS + HTTP headers, scored. The only endpoint in this group that adds mail-security analysis. Use for a one-shot decision-grade verdict on an unfamiliar domain; use /dns/lookup, /ssl/check, /security/headers, /web/audit

tools.name: get_domain_intelligence
tools.description: Collect ALL common DNS record types (A/AAAA/MX/NS/TXT/CAA) for a domain in one call -- the multi-record bundle version of /dns/lookup.

tools.name: get_web_audit
tools.description: Consolidated DNS, TLS and HTTP security audit for a public HTTPS website, returned as RAW findings (no score) -- the bundled version of /dns/lookup + /ssl/check + /security/headers. Use /security/posture instead for a 0-100 score/grade.

tools.name: get_security_posture
tools.description: Assess TLS and HTTP security posture for a public HTTPS website -- the SAME inspection as /web/audit, but returns a 0-100 score/grade and findings instead of raw fields.

tools.name: post_data_transform
tools.description: Normalize and transform common structured text automatically.

tools.name: get_security_headers
tools.description: Inspect HTTP security headers for ONE URL only. For headers combined with TLS and DNS, use /web/audit (raw) or /security/posture (scored).

tools.name: get_ssl_check
tools.description: Inspect the TLS certificate for ONE hostname only. For TLS combined with HTTP headers and DNS, use /web/audit (raw) or /security/posture (scored).

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: post_x402_service_trust_report, post_quebec_invoice_compliance_check, get_url_parse, post_domain_due_diligence, get_security_headers · Private data: get_dns_lookup, post_security_repo_risk_report_standard, post_security_repo_risk_report_deep, post_quebec_invoice_generate, get_domain_intelligence · Public sink: post_json_repair, post_media_image_convert, post_security_repo_risk_report_standard, post_security_repo_risk_report_deep, post_security_repo_risk_report_due_diligence, post_x402_service_trust_report, post_freshdep_scan, post_quebec_invoice_compliance_check, post_quebec_invoice_generate, post_json_validate, post_json_pretty, post_json_minify, post_base64_encode, post_base64_decode, post_hash_sha256, post_hash_sha512, post_text_stats, post_text_dedupe_lines, post_domain_due_diligence, post_data_transform · Destructive: post_text_dedupe_lines.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: post_x402_service_trust_report, post_quebec_invoice_compliance_check, get_url_parse, post_domain_due_diligence, get_security_headers · Private data: get_dns_lookup, post_security_repo_risk_report_standard, post_security_repo_risk_report_deep, post_quebec_invoice_generate, get_domain_intelligence · Public sink: post_json_repair, post_media_image_convert, post_security_repo_risk_report_standard, post_security_repo_risk_report_deep, post_security_repo_risk_report_due_diligence, post_x402_service_trust_report, post_freshdep_scan, post_quebec_invoice_compliance_check, post_quebec_invoice_generate, post_json_validate, post_json_pretty, post_json_minify, post_base64_encode, post_base64_decode, post_hash_sha256, post_hash_sha512, post_text_stats, post_text_dedupe_lines, post_domain_due_diligence, post_data_transform · Destructive: post_text_dedupe_lines

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
